supersedes: any S5 acceptance claim based only on package, owner-ID, generated-surface, or disable-matrix parity

closedBehaviorGaps.resolution: The complete room ledger, presence, unread, lock, lease, auto-policy, incremental-tail, task, and worker runtime is physically owned by @kernlang/agon-mod-rooms. Both legacy CLI/MCP adapters and the generated physical command consume that owner; core no longer contains or re-exports the room runtime.
closedBehaviorGaps.environmentalCell: Native fs.watch positive-path tests are locally blocked when macOS returns EMFILE. The isolated probe reproduces EMFILE outside Agon; the explicit degraded-poll path remains tested. This is not recorded as a green native-watch cell until rerun in a fresh native process environment.

closedBehaviorGaps.resolution: The physical Worktrees command now uses the shared worktree package for collision-safe session creation, dirty-state protection, age-aware dry-run pruning, dependency overlays, artifact rehydration, and exact managed-path removal. Install mode is separately network-gated, and ephemeral agent/competition worktrees are included in prune handling.

Workspace bookmarks and session worktrees are no longer conflated. The shared support package owns bookmark persistence, the Worktrees mod exposes distinct add/remove/switch/list behavior, and a narrow bundled-only host port applies session grounding.
The physical RAG owner now rejects unknown actions, preserves compact machine JSON, renders grounded file/line/score citations for humans, and reports index/stats in the established readable form.

Sanitize owns its established human and JSONL reporting without inventing a legacy run artifact. Naturalize now uses the narrow bundled host run-record port for durable run directories and terminal green/red status while retaining its physical output and JSONL presentation.

Research now uses host ranking when no engine is forced, preserves human/quiet/JSON presentation, and records durable run-directory and terminal citation-grounding status through the bundled host run-record port.

The physical Review handler now executes the established isolated mutation pass when explicitly requested, treats it as advisory without changing the review verdict, makes a lens imply semantic mutation, honors test/build overrides, warns on inert mutation-only flags, and records durable review status. The existing mutation sandbox is reached through a bundled-only compatibility port until its planned shared-runtime extraction; external folder mods receive no such authority.

The physical Forge owner now resolves an explicit cwd, orders and validates the starter, runs pre-flight health probes with visible skips, honors both early-finalization controls by aborting unfinished seats, accepts substantive no-diff validation output only when requested, preserves baseline-as-warning semantics, records durable status and candidate artifacts, emits provenance artifacts, and implements quiet run-directory presentation.

The physical Goal owner now supports read-only status, missing-field resume from persisted state, dependency ordering, bounded attempts, spend/time/no-progress/sliding-window breakers, pre-task oracle discrimination, test-change witnessing, mutation thresholds, panel review with independent judge adjudication, pre-run decomposition, durable result/summary/status artifacts, and bounded host re-exec supervision. Push/PR requests become an explicit operator promotion plan rather than an implicit network side effect.
closedBehaviorGaps.migrationNote: The process-supervisor and mutation-sandbox host ports remain explicitly transitional owners until the shared runtime extraction kill-list gates pass; they are bundled-only and absent from folder mods. This behavior audit does not waive those physical cutover gates.

verifiedDefectClasses: different commands incorrectly sharing one schema
accepted arguments whose physical handler omits the established behavior
acceptanceRule: S5 and every dependent slice remain red until exact CLI contract parity and per-argument behavioral parity pass from a clean committed checkout.
negativeControl: Removing a required field, alias, default, or nested command from a physical contribution must make the CLI parity oracle fail.
